description: Defines a SearchResponse class used for encapsulating search result data, including total count, entries, and facets.

classes.name: SearchResponse
classes.description: A class representing the response of a search operation, encapsulating total count, entry count, search entries, and facets.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of entries available from the search.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of entries available from the search.

methods.name: setEntryCount
methods.description: Sets the number of entries returned in this search response.

methods.name: getEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in this search response.

methods.name: setEntries
methods.description: Sets the list of search entries.

methods.name: getEntries
methods.description: Returns the list of search entries.

methods.name: setFacets
methods.description: Sets the map of facets for this search response.
